title: The hollow reds a build file outside writes_to
intention: The hollow reading reds a '<ticket>: build' commit that changes a file the decompose berth's writes_to does not name, so no build file goes unmeasured. Add _unplanned(tid, commit, root, planned, instrument=) to cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py. It reads `git log --format=@%H --name-only -E --grep='^<tid>: build' <anchor>..HEAD`, and returns {path: sha} for each changed path that writes_to does not name (as a file, or under a named directory) and that is not a record (history.json, state.json, validations/), the artifact journal (.artifact-journal.jsonl), or the instrument. measure() calls it for the repo, and for the commons when commons writes_to files are tracked, before directories expand. It appends one reason per path, 'unplanned: <file> was changed by build commit <sha> ...', so the verdict reds, and it returns the map as 'unplanned'.
why: Law 8: nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass, and a build file nothing reverts is exactly what a hollow green leans on. Law 3: measured 2026-10-18 over the '<tid>: build' commits since 2026-09-15, where 20 of 111 tickets changed at least one file outside writes_to (84 source, 64 proof), every one walked past the hollow unmeasured.

It appends one reason per path, 'unplanned: <file> was changed by build commit <sha> ...', so the verdict reds, and it returns the map as 'unplanned'.
falsifier: Falsifier: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_reds_a_build_file_outside_writes_to.py exits 0. (1) A '<id>: build' commit that also changes other.py, which writes_to does not name, reds with one 'unplanned' reason naming other.py and the build sha. (2) A build commit that also writes state.json, a validations/ file and .artifact-journal.jsonl gives no unplanned reason, and the verdict is green. (3) A records commit naming the ticket that changes other.py is not read, and the verdict is green. Measured 2026-10-18: tooth 1 red against today's hollow.py, and all three green with the change. Horizon: PROVED, with the hollow revert of cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py redding tooth 1.
watchme: none, because the outcome is a red reason in every hollow reading, measured by cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_reds_a_build_file_outside_writes_to.py, which reruns at every reseal touching cairn/devices/tester; a recurrence shows as that proof red, or as a build file outside writes_to in a sealed green hollow

decisions.text:
D1 (the /sorted builder_check): Questions a Haiku builder would need, answered. (a) The one file that changes is cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py: a new _unplanned() helper above _expand_dirs, a call in measure() for the repo and the commons, one 'unplanned:' reason per path beside the 'unwritten' reasons, and 'unplanned' in the returned dict. (b) The exact change is this unified diff, applied verbatim with git apply:
diff --git a/cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py b/cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py
index 9051be5a..9136e70c 100644
--- a/cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py
+++ b/cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py
@@ -842,6 +842,41 @@ def seal_isolation(proof: Path) -> str:
     return "none"
 
 
+_JOURNAL_NAME = ".artifact-journal.jsonl"
+
+
+def _unplanned(tid: str, commit: str, root: Path, planned: list[str], *,
+               instrument: frozenset[str] = frozenset()) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """{path: build sha} for each path a '<tid>: build' commit after ``commit`` changed that
+    writes_to does not name (trouble build-commit-touches-a-file-outside-writes-to).
+
+    NOTHING ELSE MEASURES SUCH A FILE. This module reverts writes_to and nothing more, and the
+    build commits place the anchor without widening the revert set — so a build that edits a
+    file its plan never named walks through green (measured 2026-10-18: 20 of 111 tickets since
+    2026-09-15). Records, the artifact journal and the instrument are what an honest build also
+    writes without a proof able to pin them, so they are not read; only build commits are, since
+    a records commit or a repair is not what the build did."""
+    proc = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), "log", "--reverse", "--format=@%H", "--name-only",
+                           "-E", f"--grep=^{tid}: build", f"{commit}..HEAD"],
+                          capture_output=True, text=True, env=git_env())
+    dirs = [p.rstrip("/") + "/" for p in planned]
+    out: dict[str, str] = {}
+    sha = ""
+    for line in proc.stdout.splitlines():
+        if line.startswith("@"):
+            sha = line[1:]
+            continue
+        rel = line.strip()
+        if not rel or rel in out or rel in planned or any(rel.startswith(d) for d in dirs):
+            continue
+        p = Path(rel)
+        if p.name == _JOURNAL_NAME or _RECORD_DIRS & set(p.parts) or p.name in _RECORD_NAMES \
+                or rel in instrument:
+            continue
+        out[rel] = sha
+    return out
+
+

     OWN build commits (those naming ``tid`` after the anchor) changed under it (ticket e08c996f939c).

     commit, at = anchor["commit"], anchor["buildme_at"]

@@ -935,6 +971,7 @@ def measure(ticket_id: str, *, repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT, commons: Path = COMM
